current.fulfillment_line: Made when you order it. Allow 3–5 days before shipping — nothing here waits in a warehouse.
current.sample_text: Tell us where to send it. A card, scented by hand, goes out by post — folded into a house envelope and closed with a wax seal. Nothing is charged, and nothing is expected of you afterwards.
current.sample_note: One sample per address. We use the address for the envelope and nothing else.
current.sample_success: Sealed and sent. Watch the letterbox — it travels the long way.
